title: Get started
goal: A first flight: send it somewhere, change its mode, bring it home and land.

steps.text: Press Go to in the Control tab, then click a place on the map.
steps.hint: Go to sends it to the place you clicked, flying forward like a plane.

steps.text: Choose LOITER in the Mode menu in the Control tab.
steps.hint: Loiter circles where it is, flying forward like a plane.

steps.text: Press Return to launch in the Control tab.
steps.hint: Return to launch flies it home.

steps.text: Press Land in the Control tab.
steps.hint: Land slows it to a hover and brings it straight down where it is. This step ticks once it's on the ground.

passed: Done. It's back on the ground.
